## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 21 ago 2026 - 21 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Richard Lawson_, 21 ago 2026, 1/5: "App is going down hill. I have two ultra twos. I like to charge one and wear one. the data gathering is not synced and doesn't work well between the two watches. Essentially makes the health app worthless. Cardio and fitness tracking is all based on paywall stuff. Not actual workouts that you're doing. I work out 4 hours every week and it tries to say I have less than an hour and 15 minutes a week of working out. The app doesn't work anymore. Pretty typical of tech these days to fail."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 jul 2026 - 23 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _chelsea hinds_, 23 ago 2026, 1/5: "since the update, the samsung health app is no longer tracking anything, it won't count my steps, it won't sync with other apps, it won't sync with the cloud, anytime I try to fix it myself the settings menu fails to load ANYTHING. It's completely unusable."
            2. _JWM B_, 24 jul 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
            3. _Adelaide Powers_, 23 ago 2026, 3/5: "I was only using the app to track my steps, most of the other stuff is stupid and useless - for me, anyway. Now app has suddenly frozen, won't track steps, can't open it. not sure if I can uninstall and reinstall. please fix. Thank you"
<!--/ir-theme-->
